title: Choozle API Vocabulary
description: Key terms and concepts used in the Choozle Reporting API and platform. Field and enum definitions are transcribed from Choozle's published apiDoc dataset at https://app.choozle.com/apidoc/api_data.json.

terms.definition: Identifier for a Choozle advertising account. Required query parameter on GET /api/reports.
Identifier for an ad group within a campaign. Optional filter on GET /api/reports; accepts one or more comma-separated ids and cannot be combined with campaign_id or campaign_status.
Authentication token obtained from POST /api/auth, valid for 2 hours from creation. Passed as the `token` request header on every reporting call.
HMAC-SHA256 digest, in lowercase hex, of the concatenated email and timestamp, keyed with the account's API private key. Required for token generation; uppercase hex and base64 are rejected.
The total number of times users clicked on an advertisement during the reporting period.
The number of attributed conversion events (e.g., purchases, sign-ups) resulting from advertising during the reporting period.
Click-Through Rate — the ratio of clicks to impressions, expressed as a decimal (clicks / impressions).
Cost Per Click — the average cost in USD for each click received on an advertisement.
Cost Per Mille — the cost in USD per one thousand ad impressions.
Demand-Side Platform — a system that allows buyers of digital advertising inventory to manage multiple ad exchange and data exchange accounts through one interface. Choozle is a self-service DSP.
Connected TV — television content delivered over the internet via smart TVs or streaming devices. Choozle supports CTV advertising channels.
Digital Out-of-Home — digital advertising displayed in public environments such as digital billboards and transit displays. Choozle supports DOOH advertising.
Real-Time Bidding — an automated auction process for buying and selling digital advertising impressions in milliseconds as a webpage loads.
Beginning of the reporting date range (inclusive), ISO 8601 date. Optional; used alone it returns reports on and after this date.
End of the reporting date range (inclusive), ISO 8601 date. Optional; used alone it returns reports on and before this date.
Identifier for a campaign within an account. Optional filter on GET /api/reports; cannot be combined with campaign_status.
Campaign status filter on GET /api/reports. One of all, active, inactive, archived. Cannot be combined with campaign_id.
Current datetime in ISO 8601 format used in the auth signature. Must be within five minutes of the Choozle server's current time.
Account lifecycle enum returned by GET /api/accounts. A: Active; I: Inactive, error with account; C: Cancelled; P: Paused.

Ad group status enum returned by GET /api/accounts. I: Incomplete; U: Unapproved; E: Enabled; D: Disabled; S: Scheduled; W: Error; O: Over Ad Group's Budget; B: Over Ad Group's Daily Budget; C: Campaign Over Budget; A: Campaign Over Daily Budget.
Cost charged to the advertiser for the reported ad group and day.
Number of impressions won in auction for the reported ad group and day.
Number of impressions bid on for the reported ad group and day.
Auction win rate for the reported ad group and day.
Cost Per Acquisition — the average cost for each attributed conversion.
Campaign archive flag returned by GET /api/accounts. Y when archived, N otherwise.
